sources.title: hercules261188/pocket-tts_text_to_speech_models - GitHub
sources.snippet: Pocket TTS A lightweight text-to-speech (TTS) application designed to run efficiently on CPUs. Forget about the hassle of using GPUs and web APIs serving TTS models. With Kyutai's Pocket TTS, generating audio is just a pip install and a function call away. Supports Python 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 and 3.14. Requires PyTorch 2.5+.
